final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the required format. For each entry, I extracted the service, level (uppercased), message, and the last line of the traceback if present as the exception. I also accounted for repeated messages by summing the repeat counts from the following lines. Finally, I aggregated counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure.
